property_summary: For every input, calling transfer with an empty _tos array must revert (require _tos.length > 0); the mutant allowing _tos.length >= 0 breaks this by returning true instead of reverting when _tos is empty.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to require(_tos.length >= 0) so calls that originally reverted for empty _tos now proceed and return true, altering observable return for that input.
